Llow it is proper to bring one’s Gifts with Faith, and how there is no Repentance after Death
1 Blessed is the man who in patience shall bring Numberless abodes for the good Sets It is impossihis gifts before the face of the Lord, for he shall avert the recompense of his sin.
2 If he speaks words out of season there is no repentance for him: if he lets the appointed time pass and does not perform the work, he is not blessed; for there is no repentance after death.
3 For every deed which a man does unseasonably 15 an offence before men, and a sin before God.
